course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Value types: why number 30 differs from text “30”
goal: Distinguish value types and explicitly convert suitable numeric text.

prerequisites.text: The preceding language lesson; saving, updating and launching your own infobase.

sections.title: Type and validity are separate
paragraphs: A type determines which operations make sense for a value. Number 30 represents a quantity; string "30" stores two characters. Similar display does not make them interchangeable. ТипЗнч reports a type without changing the variable; ТекстМинут remains a string afterwards.

-1 is numeric but invalid as our request duration. Zero is numeric and valid under the chosen rule. A variable name changes neither its type nor the requirement. Record input type, domain validity and expected action separately.

sections.title: Trace the main example
paragraphs: The original text stays a string; a separately converted number participates in addition.

code.output: The messages show number type Число, string type Строка and numeric result 45.

sections.title: Explicit conversion preserves meaning
paragraphs: Число(ТекстМинут) explicitly converts suitable numeric text. Store its result separately to compare the original representation and the new quantity. This promises no universal human-input parser: spaces, separators, units and empty input need an agreed rule.

ПреобразованныеМинуты = Число(ТекстМинут) obtains a new numeric value while preserving ТекстМинут. Keeping the original representation supports diagnosis and an explanation of acceptance. Do not calculate from arbitrary text with unknown units.

sections.title: Empty does not mean zero
paragraphs: Неопределено denotes an unspecified value in its context, not numeric zero or an empty string. An empty string already has a string type; zero already has a number type. ЗначениеЗаполнено can treat zero as unfilled, but that is not automatically the application rule for zero duration. Define the field’s meaning first.

Record three observations: numeric 0 has a number type; "" is a string; Неопределено is not a known duration. A technical filled-value predicate does not choose business rules. Replacing missing data with 0 can produce a plausible total while hiding the cause.

sections.title: Zero is a known quantity
paragraphs: A known zero quantity differs from an unspecified value.

sections.title: Conversion boundaries
paragraphs: Check input type, then range and the intended operation. ТипЗнч output observes a type; result 45 observes arithmetic after conversion. Explain both independently. Handling invalid numeric text is covered with exceptions later; silently turning unknown input into zero hides an error.

Parsing "30" does not establish acceptance of "30 minutes", arbitrary separators or empty input. Those need a separate contract and rejection handling. Exception handling is covered later; do not claim universal validation from one accepted input.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Matching display means matching types. Compare ТипЗнч rather than displayed characters alone.
Empty or invalid input can always become zero. That destroys the distinction between known zero and missing/invalid input.

selfcheck.feedback: Quotes denote text; similar display does not make it numeric.

selfcheck.prompt: What does Число(ТекстМинут) do when its result is assigned elsewhere?
options: Permanently changes the original variable’s type
Returns a number while the original text remains a string
selfcheck.feedback: Conversion returns a value; assigning it elsewhere leaves the source string intact.

selfcheck.prompt: Why should unknown duration not silently become zero?
options: That loses the distinction between known zero and missing/invalid input
selfcheck.feedback: The domain defines whether zero is valid; absence and error are different states.

selfcheck.prompt: Specify duration input without silently converting errors into zero.
selfcheck.feedback: Define accepted type/representation, range and response to unknown formats.
